params = {}
params['tree_method'] = 'hist'
params['predictor'] = 'predictor'
params['n_jobs'] = 4



n_splits = 10
test_preds = None
kf_rmse = []
for fold, (train_idx, valid_idx) in enumerate(KFold(n_splits=n_splits, shuffle=True).split(X_train,y_train)):

    X_train, y_train = X_train[train_idx], y_train[train_idx]
    X_valid, y_valid = X_train[valid_idx], y_train[valid_idx]


    model = XGBRegressor(**params)
    model.fit(X_train, y_train,
            eval_set=[(X_valid, y_valid)],
            eval_metric='rmse', verbose=False)


    valid_pred = model.predict(X_valid)

    rmse = np.sqrt(mean_squared_error(y_valid, valid_pred))
    print(f'Fold {fold+1}/{n_splits} RMSE: {rmse:.4f}')
    kf_rmse.append(rmse)


    if test_preds is None:
        test_preds = model.predict(X_test)
    else:

        test_preds += model.predict(X_test)

test_preds /= n_splits
print(f'Average KFold RMSE: {np.mean(np.array(kf_rmse)):.5f}')

params = {}
params['tree_method'] = 'hist'
params['predictor'] = 'auto'
params['n_jobs'] = 4

n_splits = 10
test_preds = None
kf_rmse = []

for fold, (train_idx, valid_idx) in enumerate(KFold(n_splits=n_splits, shuffle=True, random_state=42).split(X_train, y_train)):
    # Use positional indexing for pandas objects and avoid overwriting full training data
    X_tr = X_train.iloc[train_idx]
    y_tr = y_train.iloc[train_idx]
    X_valid = X_train.iloc[valid_idx]
    y_valid = y_train.iloc[valid_idx]

    model = XGBRegressor(**params)
    model.fit(
        X_tr, y_tr,
        eval_set=[(X_valid, y_valid)],
        eval_metric='rmse',
        verbose=False
    )

    valid_pred = model.predict(X_valid)
    rmse = np.sqrt(mean_squared_error(y_valid, valid_pred))
    print(f'Fold {fold+1}/{n_splits} RMSE: {rmse:.4f}')
    kf_rmse.append(rmse)

    if test_preds is None:
        test_preds = model.predict(X_test)
    else:
        test_preds += model.predict(X_test)

test_preds /= n_splits
print(f'Average KFold RMSE: {np.mean(np.array(kf_rmse)):.5f}')
